verses.en: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful.
By the night when it covers up!
And by the day when it brightens up,
And by the creating of the male and the female,
Surely, your strivings are diverse.
Then as for him who gives and is righteous,
And testifies to the truth of what is right,
We will facilitate for him every facility.
But as for him who is niggardly and is disdainfully indifferent,
And rejects what is right,
We will make easy for him the path to distress.
w: We will make easy for him

verses.ar: وَمَا یُغۡنِیۡ عَنۡہُ مَالُہٗۤ اِذَا تَرَدّٰی ﴿ؕ۱۲﴾
verses.en: And his wealth shall not avail him when he perishes.
Surely it is for Us to guide;
And to Us belongs the Hereafter as well as the present world.
w: as well as the present world

verses.en: So I warn you of a flaming Fire.
None shall enter it but the most wicked one,
Who rejects the truth and turns his back.
But the righteous one shall be kept away from it,
w: but shall be kept away from it

verses.en: Who gives his wealth to become purified.

verses.ar: وَمَا لِاَحَدٍ عِنۡدَہٗ مِنۡ نِّعۡمَۃٍ تُجۡزٰۤی ﴿ۙ۲۰﴾
verses.en: And he owes no favour to anyone, which is to be repaid,
Except that he gives his wealth to seek the pleasure of his Lord, the Most High.
And soon will He be well pleased with him.
w: will He be well pleased with him
